title: fix(supply): a speed promise refuses every host of an unmeasured release
description:
## .what

the speed promise keeps a host only when `throughputTps !== null`. a release no host has yet been
measured on has every throughput null, so every speed-promised slug refuses before a call is sent.
that includes the bare tier `openrouter/deepseek/flash`, whose tier implies min50tps.

## .evidence

measured 2026-10-17: the deepseek/flash tier resolved to `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`
(released that day). openrouter listed five endpoints, each with `throughput_last_30m: null`. every
ask refused with `no endpoint ... keeps every promise`, funnel `4 ← supports(...)`,
`0 ← speed>=100tps`. this held across a ci rerun, so a retry cannot cure it until openrouter
measures the hosts.

## .the shape of the fix

1. in `getAllPromiseChecks`, when no endpoint has a measured throughput, the speed promise cannot be
   judged: waive it (keep every host). once any host is measured, an unmeasured host still fails
2. surface the waiver in the funnel line, e.g. `speed>=100tps (waived: no host measured)`, so the
   caller sees why an unproven host may serve
3. clamp: all-null endpoints qualify; mixed endpoints keep only the measured, fast host; all
   measured-slow still refuses

## .found

rhachet-roles-bhrain @ beav/feat-review-cost-meter, patched locally via pnpm `patchedDependencies`
with a clamp (`src/.test/openrouterUnmeasuredSpeedPromise.test.ts`), 2026-10-17
